name: Defense and Energy committed item feedback
steps: Open Defense in a disposable save: both backpack and selected-item panels are neutral gray and CCTV caption reads only CCTV.
Load rifle ammo on each corner; switch Assault/Sniper. Both glyph and label center at the same vertical point in each28px action; Sniper shows a distinct valid target icon.

Install a turret, load ammo, install a silencer and each optic using held-item and backpack-picker actions. Each completed item placement plays exactly one native item-place sound, including the item's SoundPlace override when present.
Attempt invalid item, occupied target, stale operation and denied placement. No item-place sound. Idle through periodic refreshes and change item-free toggles: no item-place sound.

Install generator/battery/solar sources, insert components/batteries/cells and refuel. Audio occurs only when committed actor after-image retires, not at command admission or intermediate saving state.
Repeat on remote client with delayed or duplicated success packets. Exactly one placement sound per successful operation; no sound on queries, failed responses, historical recovery or save/reload.
Resize to normal and reduced screen sizes; inspect centered mode labels, valid icons, unclipped CCTV and unchanged readable item details.
For all four turret rows, OFF has yellow actionFill and ON has green actionFill; hover retains the state hue and unrelated actions keep their standard neutral fill.
limitations: Static contracts and staged compile pass; native visual/audio execution remains to be tested by the user.
